title: Increase Muon matrix learning rate to 0.05
description: MATRIX_LR 0.04 → 0.05 (25% increase to strengthen signal on transformer matrices)
reflection: val_bpb 0.997323 vs baseline 0.996553: regression of +0.000770. All three agents independently converged on this untested idea, suggesting it was worth testing. However, the increase proved detrimental—the baseline 15:1 embedding:matrix LR ratio is actually better-tuned than the 12:1 ratio achieved here. This confirms the tight local optimum extends even to parameter-group-specific learning rates. Single-parameter changes continue to fail uniformly. Future experiments should either: (1) test multi-parameter coordinated changes (simultaneous adjustments to related hyperparameters), or (2) explore fundamentally different architectures (activation functions, attention patterns, layer design). The baseline model/optimizer remains remarkably well-optimized.
